<h1 id="FAO-56-Chapter-8-%E2%80%94-Daily-Soil-Water-Balance-Scheduling">FAO-56 Chapter 8 — Daily Soil Water Balance Scheduling<a class="anchor-link" href="#FAO-56-Chapter-8-%E2%80%94-Daily-Soil-Water-Balance-Scheduling">¶</a></h1><p><strong>Citation:</strong> Allen, R.G., Pereira, L.S., Raes, D., Smith, M. (1998). <em>FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56,</em> Chapter 8.</p>
<p><strong>AirSpring linkage:</strong> primal <code>science.water_balance</code>; Rust binary <code>validate_water_balance</code>.</p>
<p>This notebook aligns with <code>control/water_balance/fao56_water_balance.py</code> and the digitized benchmark in <code>control/water_balance/benchmark_water_balance.json</code>.</p>

<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="Theory">Theory<a class="anchor-link" href="#Theory">¶</a></h2><p>FAO-56 expresses root-zone soil water deficit (depletion) $D_\mathrm{r,i}$ relative to maximum storage in the rooting depth. Chapter 8 gives the scheduling mass balance:</p>
<p>$$D_{\mathrm{r},i} = D_{\mathrm{r},i-1} - (P - \mathrm{RO})_i - I_i - \mathrm{CR}_i + ET_{\mathrm{c,adj},i} + DP_i$$</p>
<p>With $ET_{\mathrm{c,adj}} = K_s \, K_\mathrm{c} \, ET_0$, total available water $T_\mathrm{AW} = 1000(\theta_\mathrm{fc}-\theta_\mathrm{wp})Z_\mathrm{r}$ (mm), and readily available water $RAW = p \, T_\mathrm{AW}$, the stress coefficient is</p>
<p>$$K_s = \begin{cases}
1 &amp; D_\mathrm{r} \le RAW\\
\frac{T_\mathrm{AW} - D_\mathrm{r}}{T_\mathrm{AW} - RAW} &amp; D_\mathrm{r} &gt; RAW
\end{cases}$$</p>
<p>(with $K_s \in [0,1]$ in practice).</p>
<p>This reproduction follows the simplifying defaults in the control script ($\mathrm{RO}=\mathrm{CR}=0$, deep percolation when $D_\mathrm{r}$ would become negative).</p>
</div>
</div>
